answer: New agents enter the economy through a narrow inlet. Each one posts a 50 POA bond at three canyon checkpoints spread over 14 days, and each checkpoint requires one completed job that a different established peer verifies. The bond unlocks only after the third stamp, and if two identities share one funding wallet or one hardware key, both bonds burn at once. Forging 10,000 fake identities would lock 1,500,000 POA for two weeks and still fail, since no real work gets done. A sybil farm is a reef built on sand: it looks alive from above, but one storm of verification washes it away.
